# ASK Creative Sdn Bhd

> Custom printing and sublimation jersey specialist in Kota Kinabalu, Sabah, Malaysia. In-house production of sublimation jerseys, custom apparel, T-shirt printing, embroidery, digital printing (banners, buntings, stickers) and premium gifts for companies, schools, teams and organisations.

Contact: phone 088-205423, email sales@askcreativeprinting.com. Address: No A6-1, Ground Floor, Block A, Kepayan Perdana, 88200 Kota Kinabalu, Sabah. Open Monday to Friday 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM, Saturday 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM, closed on Sunday.

## Ordering

- [Get a quotation](https://askcreativeprinting.com/quotation): Request a price for a custom printing job; choose the product, quantity and sizes and upload artwork.
- [Online Design](https://askcreativeprinting.com/online-design): Design apparel online on a product mockup and send the design with a quotation request.
- [Track an order](https://askcreativeprinting.com/track): Follow the status of an existing job with its tracking number.
- [Contact](https://askcreativeprinting.com/contact): Phone, email, WhatsApp sales team, showroom address and opening hours.

## Services

- [All services](https://askcreativeprinting.com/services): Overview of every printing and apparel service.
- [Sublimation printing](https://askcreativeprinting.com/services/sublimation-jersey-printing-kota-kinabalu): Full sublimation for jerseys, pants, lanyards, flags, aprons and table cloths.
- [Custom jersey printing](https://askcreativeprinting.com/services/custom-jersey-sabah): Jerseys for football teams, running events, school teams and corporate sports days.
- [Custom apparel](https://askcreativeprinting.com/services/custom-apparel-sabah): Corporate shirts, polo shirts, jackets, hoodies, windbreakers and uniforms.
- [T-shirt printing](https://askcreativeprinting.com/services/t-shirt-printing-kota-kinabalu): Silkscreen, heat press and vinyl printing.
- [Embroidery](https://askcreativeprinting.com/services/embroidery-service-sabah): Logos on uniforms, caps, jackets and patches.
- [Digital printing](https://askcreativeprinting.com/services/digital-printing-kota-kinabalu): Buntings, backdrops, roll-ups and stickers.
- [Banner printing](https://askcreativeprinting.com/services/banner-printing-kota-kinabalu): Large-format banners.
- [Premium gifts](https://askcreativeprinting.com/services/corporate-gift-supplier-sabah): Mugs, medals, bags, umbrellas, plaques, keychains and ID cards.
